LanguageData.RimTaiName_Settings_PrivacyText:
• Names (plus gender, backstories and similar in phase 2) are sent over HTTPS to Google's Gemini API only when you press "Translate name", "Generate Chinese name" or "Test connection". This mod collects no statistics.
• Content sent on the free tier is used by Google to improve its products. Under the Gemini API terms, users in the EEA, Switzerland and the UK may only use paid services.
• Create a dedicated key for this mod in Google AI Studio, in a project without billing: it can then only use the free quota and cannot cost money if it leaks. New keys (starting with "AQ.") can only call the Gemini API by default.
• If you suspect a leak, delete and recreate the key in AI Studio, then press "Clear key" above.
• Other mods running in the same game could in theory read the key from memory; this cannot be fully prevented.
